rationale: Dylan brings deep domain expertise in AI-powered career guidance and edtech with hands-on founder-level technical curiosity, while Symphony Creative Studio sits at the intersection of generative AI and creator tooling—two adjacent spaces where AI is fundamentally reshaping how content and guidance are produced at scale. Dylan's conviction that AI solves the scaling problem in traditionally under-resourced verticals, combined with his GTM background from Salesforce, could offer useful perspective on how generative AI tools drive adoption in performance-sensitive domains like advertising and education.
intro_message: Dylan Bryan, meet Symphony Creative Studio — you're both working on how generative AI scales human expertise, Dylan in career guidance and Symphony in creative production, so you might find useful parallels in how you're thinking about creator/user adoption.
